pages.about: Sandhill Craft Supply stocks materials for knitting, papercraft, printmaking and embroidery. We began as a market stall and now supply hobbyists and a handful of teaching studios. Trade pricing is available for workshops and schools.
pages.refund_policy: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery in unused, resaleable condition with original packaging. Cut yarn and opened ink are non-returnable unless faulty. Refunds issued within 5 business days of receipt.
pages.shipping_policy: Orders dispatched within 2 business days. Standard delivery $5.50, free over $60, arriving in 3-5 business days. Yarn orders over ten skeins ship in a single box.
